access: A kubeconfig context for the cluster with RBAC get and list on pods, pods/log and events in the namespace

presentation.name: Summarise Kubernetes pod logs as distinct errors, read-only
presentation.summary: Reads the logs of Kubernetes pods with read-only kubectl and reports each distinct error once, with its count, time span, pods and root cause.
benefits: Groups thousands of repeated lines into distinct errors with counts, first and last time and the pods affected
Finds the root cause in Java Caused by chains, Python tracebacks and PySpark errors that mix both
Reads crashed containers and pod status, so an out-of-memory kill is not reported as a clean log
Locates Airflow scheduler, worker and task pods and Spark drivers and executors by their labels
Never changes the cluster or the active kubeconfig context, and redacts secrets from the summary
